description: Gets a public discussion on Veritula by its id (from search results or its address, veritula.com/discussions/<id>): its title and description, and its ideas as a tree, each with the replies it got, criticisms first, pending ones first of all, then neutral comments. Ideas are given in brief; get_idea gives one in full.

id.description: The discussion’s id, as search results give it

name: get_discussion
title: Get a discussion
